name: shuffle-album-mix
title: Album Mix Shuffle
summary: Adds Album Mix to Settings > Shuffle.
description: Album Mix plays the albums in a random order and shuffles the songs in each album. Apple put this mode in the firmware, but no menu item switched it on.
details: Settings > Shuffle: Off, Songs, Albums, Album Mix.
A change between Albums and Album Mix shuffles the play list again.
Settings > Main Menu has a Shuffle row. Set it to On to show the item "Shuffle: Off" in the main menu.
Select that item to go to the next value. The item does not start the music.
notes: This patch needs Shuffle Fixes. Without it, Album Mix repeats some songs and does not play other songs.
The text "Album Mix" is in English for all languages.
Accessories see Album Mix as Albums.
Install Instant Save to keep the Settings > Main Menu row after a restart with Menu+Select.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch and Shuffle Fixes.
Select Shuffle three times. The value is Album Mix.
Select Shuffle Songs in the main menu.
Make sure that the albums and the songs in each album play in a random order.
To show Shuffle in the main menu, open Settings > Main Menu and set Shuffle to On.
